title: Indian IT's AI revenue just crossed 10%
takeaways: TCS: annualised AI revenue of $3.1 billion, over 10% of revenue.
Infosys: AI is 10.5% of revenue, up from 5.5% in February.
HCLTech: advanced AI revenue of $219 million, up 28.4% in a quarter.
TCS overall revenue grew just 0.5% sequentially in constant currency.
Gartner: India software spending to grow 17.6% in 2026.
source_note: Sources: TCS, Infosys, HCLTech Q2 FY27; Elets CIO; AIM; Gartner
